an6.66:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ,
an6.66:1.3: thinaṃ, middhaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, kukkuccaṃ, assaddhiyaṃ, pamādaṃ.
an6.66:1.4: ime kho cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.66:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.66:2.3: thinaṃ middhaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, kukkuccaṃ, assaddhiyaṃ, pamādaṃ.
an6.66:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti.
